hindi: किन्तु काल से प्रेरित रावण ने उन वचनों की अवहेलना करके मारीच के साथ तब उसके आश्रम-स्थान को प्रस्थान किया।
english: But Rāvaṇa, impelled by fate, disregarding those words, then went together with Mārīca to his hermitage.
notes: tasya 'his' refers to the person whose hermitage it is (not named in this verse); kāla may be 'time' or 'fate/death'.

hindi: उस मायावी के द्वारा दोनों राजकुमारों को दूर हटवाकर, उसने जटायु गृध्र को मारकर राम की भार्या का हरण किया।
english: Having had the two princes drawn far away by that master of illusion, he carried off Rāma's wife, after killing the vulture Jaṭāyus.
notes: apavāhya with tena māyāvinā: the leading-away is done through the illusionist; the subject (he) is Rāvaṇa from the previous verse.

hindi: गृध्र को मारा हुआ देखकर और मैथिली का हरण सुनकर, शोक से संतप्त राघव व्याकुल इन्द्रियों वाले होकर विलाप करने लगे।
english: Seeing the vulture slain and hearing that the princess of Mithilā had been carried off, the Rāghava, burning with grief, his senses in turmoil, lamented.

words.gram: m. nom. sg., pres. part. ātm. √mārg

hindi: तब उसी शोक में जटायु गृध्र का दाह करके, वन में सीता को खोजते हुए उन्होंने एक राक्षस को देखा।
english: Then, in that same grief, having cremated the vulture Jaṭāyus, while searching the forest for Sītā he saw a rākṣasa (demon).

hindi: कबन्ध नामक, रूप से विकृत और घोर दर्शन वाले उस राक्षस को मारकर महाबाहु ने उसे जलाया, और वह स्वर्ग चला गया।
english: The mighty-armed one, having slain him, Kabandha by name, deformed in form and dreadful to behold, cremated him; and he went to heaven.
notes: 'svargataś ca saḥ': the one who went to heaven is the slain Kabandha, not the slayer (the subject of nihatya/dadāha).

hindi: और उसने उनसे कहा — "हे राघव, धर्म का आचरण करने वाली, धर्म में निपुण श्रमणी शबरी के पास जाओ।" वे महातेजस्वी शत्रुसूदन शबरी के पास गए।
english: And he told him: "O Rāghava, go to Śabarī, the woman ascetic who practises dharma and is skilled in dharma." He, the destroyer of enemies, of great splendour, went to Śabarī.
notes: Three-line unit as in the edition. 'sa' (he who told) is the one cremated in the previous verse, by context; the line itself does not name him.

words.gloss: on the bank of the Pampā

hindi: शबरी के द्वारा भली-भाँति पूजित दशरथ-पुत्र राम पम्पा के तट पर हनुमान् वानर से मिले।
english: Rāma, son of Daśaratha, duly honoured by Śabarī, met the monkey Hanumat on the bank of the Pampā.

hindi: और हनुमान् के वचन से ही वे सुग्रीव से मिले, और महाबली राम ने सुग्रीव को वह सब कह सुनाया।
english: And at Hanumat's word indeed he met with Sugrīva; and Rāma of great strength told Sugrīva all that.
notes: śaṃsat taken as an augmentless imperfect (epic usage) = aśaṃsat 'told'; as a present participle the nom. sg. would be śaṃsan, so the finite reading is preferred.

words.gram: n. nom. sg., ppp caus. ā-√vid

hindi: तब दुःखी वानरराज ने प्रेमवश वैर की पूरी कथा राम को निवेदित की, और वहाँ उस वानर ने वालि का बल भी बताया।
english: Then the king of the monkeys, grieved, out of affection made known to Rāma everything concerning the tale of the enmity; and there the monkey told of Vālin's strength.
notes: Three-line unit as in the edition. 'vairānukathanaṃ prati' = with regard to the narration of the feud; the feud's parties are not named in this verse.

hindi: और राम ने तब वालि-वध के विषय में प्रतिज्ञा की; किन्तु सुग्रीव राघव के पराक्रम के विषय में निरन्तर शंकित रहा।
english: And Rāma then made a promise concerning the slaying of Vālin; but Sugrīva was constantly doubtful about the prowess in the Rāghava.
notes: 'vīryeṇa rāghave' = doubtful as to (the) prowess in the Rāghava, i.e. whether Rāghava had the strength; literal rendering kept.

words.gloss: with the big toe of his foot

hindi: किन्तु राघव ने विश्वास दिलाने के लिए दुन्दुभि के विशाल शरीर को पैर के अँगूठे से पूरे दस योजन दूर फेंक दिया।
english: But the Rāghava, to inspire confidence, flung the huge body of Dundubhi a full ten yojanas with the big toe of his foot.
notes: uttamam here 'huge/foremost' describing the body; a yojana is a measure of distance (kept as yojana).

words.gram: m. nom. sg., pres. part. caus. √jan

hindi: और फिर, विश्वास उत्पन्न करते हुए, उन्होंने तब एक ही महान बाण से सात साल वृक्षों, एक पर्वत और रसातल तक को भेद दिया।
english: And moreover, producing confidence, he then pierced seven sāla trees, a mountain and even Rasātala with a single great arrow.

hindi: तब उससे प्रसन्नचित्त और विश्वस्त हुआ वह महाकपि राम के साथ किष्किन्धा गुफा को गया।
english: Then that great monkey, glad at heart and made confident by this, went together with Rāma to the cave Kiṣkindhā.
notes: guhām in apposition to kiṣkindhām: Kiṣkindhā is called a cave here.

hindi: तब स्वर्ण के समान पिङ्गल वर्ण वाला हरिश्रेष्ठ सुग्रीव गरजा; उस महान नाद से हरीश्वर बाहर निकल आया।
english: Then Sugrīva, best of monkeys, tawny as gold, roared; at that great roar the lord of monkeys came out.
notes: harīśvaraḥ (the one who came out) is not named in this verse; by context it is the monkey lord inside Kiṣkindhā, whose slaying follows in 55 (Vālin).

hindi: तब सुग्रीव के वचन से युद्ध में वालि को मारकर राघव ने सुग्रीव को ही उस राज्य में स्थापित किया।
english: Then, at Sugrīva's word, having slain Vālin in battle, the Rāghava established Sugrīva himself in that kingdom.

hindi: और उस वानरश्रेष्ठ ने, जनक-पुत्री को देखने की इच्छा से, सब वानरों को एकत्र करके दिशाओं में भेजा।
english: And he, that bull among monkeys, having gathered all the monkeys, sent them out to the directions, wishing to see the daughter of Janaka.
notes: vānararṣabhaḥ: -rṣabha- after -a- is the printed sandhi of vānara + ṛṣabha (a + ṛ = ar).

hindi: तब गृध्र सम्पाति के वचन से बलवान् हनुमान् ने सौ योजन विस्तृत लवण-समुद्र को लाँघ लिया।
english: Then, at the word of the vulture Sampāti, mighty Hanumat leapt across the salt ocean, a hundred yojanas wide.

hindi: वहाँ रावण द्वारा पालित लङ्का नगरी में पहुँचकर उसने अशोक-वाटिका में गई हुई, ध्यानमग्न सीता को देखा।
english: There, having reached the city of Laṅkā ruled by Rāvaṇa, he saw Sītā, brooding, who had gone to the aśoka grove.
notes: pālitām 'protected/ruled'; aśoka is a tree name, kept as aśoka.

hindi: पहचान का चिह्न देकर और समाचार सुनाकर, तथा वैदेही को आश्वासन देकर, उसने तोरण को तोड़ डाला।
english: Having presented the token of recognition and reported the news, and having consoled the princess of Videha, he smashed the gateway arch.

hindi: पाँच सेनानायकों और सात मन्त्रि-पुत्रों को भी मारकर, तथा वीर अक्ष को कुचलकर, वह बन्दी बनाया गया।
english: Having killed five army leaders and seven sons of ministers too, and having crushed the hero Akṣa, he submitted to capture.

words.gram: m. nom. sg., pres. part. caus. √mṛṣ

hindi: पितामह के वर के कारण अपने को अस्त्र से मुक्त जानकर भी, वह वीर अपनी इच्छा से उन बाँधने वाले राक्षसों को सहता रहा।
english: Knowing himself released from the missile by reason of the boon of the Grandsire, the hero, of his own accord, tolerated those rākṣasas who were binding him.

text_flags.why: 'unmuham' is not a Sanskrit word; 'unmuktam' (released) fits sense and the 8-syllable pāda; typing error (ha for kta).

notes: paitāmahād varāt: 'from the Grandsire's boon' = because of the boon granted by Brahmā. Reading unmuktam taken from the flag.

hindi: तब मैथिली सीता को छोड़कर लङ्का नगरी को जलाकर, महाकपि राम को प्रिय समाचार सुनाने के लिए फिर लौट आया।
english: Then, having burnt the city of Laṅkā, except for Sītā the princess of Mithilā, the great monkey came back to tell Rāma the good news.
notes: ṛte governs the accusative here (sītāṃ ca maithilīm): burnt the city but spared Sītā.

hindi: अमेय आत्मा वाले उसने महात्मा राम के पास जाकर और उनकी प्रदक्षिणा करके यथार्थ रूप से निवेदन किया — "सीता देख ली गई है।"
english: He, of immeasurable spirit, having approached the great-souled Rāma and circumambulated him, reported truthfully: "Sītā has been seen."

hindi: तब सुग्रीव के साथ महासागर के तट पर जाकर उन्होंने सूर्य के समान बाणों से समुद्र को क्षुब्ध कर दिया।
english: Then, having gone with Sugrīva to the shore of the great ocean, he agitated the sea with arrows resembling the sun.

hindi: और नदियों के स्वामी समुद्र ने स्वयं को प्रकट किया; और समुद्र के वचन से ही उन्होंने नल से सेतु बनवाया।
english: And Samudra, the lord of rivers, showed himself; and at the Ocean's word indeed he had Nala build a causeway.

hindi: उससे लङ्का नगरी में जाकर और युद्ध में रावण को मारकर उन्होंने लङ्का में विभीषण का राक्षसराज के रूप में अभिषेक किया।
english: Having gone by it to the city of Laṅkā and slain Rāvaṇa in battle, he consecrated Vibhīṣaṇa in Laṅkā as lord of the rākṣasas.
notes: tena 'by that' = by the causeway of the previous verse.

words.gloss: with its moving and unmoving beings
with its hosts of gods and sages

hindi: महात्मा राघव के उस महान कर्म से चर-अचर सहित और देव तथा ऋषियों के समूहों सहित तीनों लोक संतुष्ट हुए।
english: By that great deed of the great-souled Rāghava, the three worlds with their moving and unmoving beings, with their hosts of gods and sages, were pleased.
notes: sadevarṣigaṇam may also be read sa-devarṣi-gaṇam 'with its hosts of divine sages (devarṣi)'.

hindi: इस प्रकार परम संतुष्ट समस्त देवताओं द्वारा पूजित, कृतकृत्य और चिन्तारहित राम तब आनन्दित हुए।
english: Thus, honoured by all the deities, who were supremely pleased, Rāma, his task accomplished and free from anguish, then rejoiced.

hindi: देवताओं से वर पाकर और वानरों को उठाकर, उस पुष्पक पर चढ़कर वे तब नन्दिग्राम गए।
english: Having obtained boons from the deities and raised up the monkeys, he then mounted that Puṣpaka and went to Nandigrāma.
notes: samutthāpya 'having raised up' (the monkeys): the verse does not say from what; literal rendering kept. Puṣpaka is something mounted (samāruhya); the line does not say what it is.

words.gram: m. nom. sg., past act. part. ava-√āp

hindi: नन्दिग्राम में जटा को त्यागकर, भाइयों सहित निष्पाप राम ने सीता को पुनः पाकर फिर से राज्य प्राप्त किया।
english: In Nandigrāma, having given up his matted hair, the sinless Rāma, together with his brothers, having regained Sītā, obtained the kingdom again.

hindi: लोग प्रहृष्ट और प्रमुदित, संतुष्ट, पुष्ट, अत्यन्त धार्मिक, रोगरहित और नीरोग तथा दुर्भिक्ष और भय से रहित थे।
english: The people were delighted and joyful, content, well-nourished, very righteous, free from disease and free from sickness, free of famine and fear.

text_flags.why: 'nirāyama' is not a word; 'nirāmaya' (free from disease) is the expected form, paired with aroga; syllables transposed (ya/ma).

notes: 'nirāmayo arogaś' shows unresolved vowel hiatus (o + a) in the edition's own text; kept as printed, not a flag. lokaḥ 'the people/world'; the verse has no finite verb, 'were' supplied.

hindi: कोई भी पुरुष कहीं भी पुत्र की मृत्यु नहीं देखेंगे, और स्त्रियाँ सदा अविधवा और पतिव्रता रहेंगी।
english: No men anywhere will see the death of a son; and women will always be unwidowed and devoted to their husbands.
notes: The edition prints 'ke cit' and 'kva cit' as two tokens each; avidhavāḥ loses its visarga before n- (avidhavā nityaṃ).

hindi: वायु से उत्पन्न कोई भय नहीं है, जीव जल में नहीं डूबते, और अग्नि से उत्पन्न भी कोई भय नहीं है; जैसा कृतयुग में था, वैसा ही है।
english: There is no danger at all from wind, creatures do not drown in the waters, and there is no danger at all from fire; as in the Kṛta age, so it is.

text_flags.why: 'agrija' (first-born) gives no sense beside vātajaṃ bhayam; 'agnijam' (born of fire) is the expected parallel; gra/gna typing slip.

notes: Verbless first clauses; 'is' supplied. The surrounding verses are future predictions, but majjanti is present and is translated as such.

hindi: सैकड़ों अश्वमेधों से तथा बहुसुवर्णक यज्ञों से यज्ञ करके, विद्वानों को विधिपूर्वक करोड़ों और अयुतों गौएँ देकर,
english: Having sacrificed with hundreds of horse sacrifices and likewise with Bahusuvarṇaka rites, having given crores and myriads of cows to the learned according to rite,
notes: Sentence continues into 75 (finite verb sthāpayiṣyati). bahusuvarṇaka: name of a sacrifice characterised by much gold; kept as a name. koṭyayutam: koṭi (ten million) and ayuta (ten thousand), i.e. a vast number; could also be read as 'a koṭi of ayutas'.

hindi: राघव सौ गुने राजवंशों को स्थापित करेंगे, और इस लोक में चारों वर्णों को अपने-अपने धर्म में नियुक्त करेंगे।
english: the Rāghava will establish royal lineages a hundredfold, and in this world he will set the four classes each in its own dharma.
notes: Continues the sentence begun in 74. 'sve sve' repeated = 'each in its own'.

hindi: दस हज़ार वर्ष और दस सौ वर्ष राज्य का पालन करके राम ब्रह्मलोक को जाएँगे।
english: Having ruled the kingdom for ten thousand years and ten hundred years, Rāma will go to the world of Brahmā.
notes: upāsitvā literally 'having attended upon, served' the kingdom, i.e. ruled.

hindi: जो इस पवित्र, पापनाशक, पुण्यमय और वेदों के समान राम-चरित को पढ़ता है, वह सब पापों से मुक्त हो जाता है।
english: Whoever recites this story of Rāma's deeds, purifying, sin-destroying, meritorious and equal to the Vedas, is freed from all sins.

hindi: इस आयुवर्धक आख्यान रामायण को पढ़ने वाला मनुष्य पुत्र-पौत्रों और अपने गणों सहित मरने के बाद स्वर्ग में सम्मानित होता है।
english: A man reciting this life-giving narrative, the Rāmāyaṇa, together with sons and grandsons and his retinue, is honoured in heaven after death.
notes: gaṇa 'group, retinue, attendants'; could also be 'kinsfolk'.

hindi: इसे पढ़ने वाला द्विज वाणी में श्रेष्ठता प्राप्त करे; यदि क्षत्रिय हो तो भूमि का स्वामित्व प्राप्त करे; वणिक्-जन व्यापार का फल प्राप्त करे; और शूद्र जन भी महत्ता प्राप्त करे।
english: A twice-born reciting it would attain excellence in speech; should he be a kṣatriya, he would attain lordship of the earth; a merchant would attain profit from his wares; and even a śūdra would attain greatness.

text_flags.why: stray combining mark under the final t (Devanagari has a stray svara mark ॑ after ईयात्); the word is īyāt, a pāda-end mark of the edition's typing, not a letter.
stray combining mark under the final j (same stray ॑ in the Devanagari); īyāt + janaḥ gives īyāj janaḥ by sandhi, so the base letters are right.

notes: Upajāti-type verse (11 syllables a quarter, two quarters per printed line); the stray marks sit at the quarter boundaries. vāgṛṣabhatvam literally 'the state of being a bull (foremost) in speech'. 'syāt' taken as 'if he be'; it could also be a mere optative particle.
